description: Full detail of one act by its id (Διαύγεια ΑΔΑ, ΚΗΜΔΗΣ 'kimdis:<ΑΔΑΜ>', or TED 'ted:<number>'): canonical fields, resolved buyer/supplier entities, CPV codes with labels, and its cross-source lifecycle chain if linked. On ΚΗΜΔΗΣ contracts, `commitment_ada` carries the Διαύγεια ΑΔΑ of the budget-commitment decision the source declares (comma-separated when more than one). It is a pointer INTO Διαύγεια, not an act we necessarily hold — resolve it at diavgeia.gov.gr, not through this API — and it is deliberately NOT a chain edge: one annual commitment funds many unrelated contracts. On tenders and public-works awards/contracts, `discount` carries the contractor discount (official from the document, or calculated) — see its schema.
name: get_act

amount_check.description: JSON verdict when the published amount looks wrong, e.g. {"outcome":"scale_suspect","original":809100000}

award_procedure.description: statutory exception (art. 32 ν.4412/2016) the buyer invoked to skip a competitive call. Published on ~100% of «negotiated without prior publication» / «competitive procedure with negotiation» / «competitive dialogue» acts and on ~0% of others — so null means NOT REQUIRED, not missing, except on those three procedures where it is a genuine anomaly.

chain_id.description: lifecycle chain this act belongs to, null if unlinked

contract_budget_net.description: the document's own approved budget — compare with amount_net to spot cumulative/typo figures

id.description: canonical act id — Διαύγεια ΑΔΑ, 'kimdis:<ΑΔΑΜ>' or 'ted:<publication-number>'

procedure_type.description: Ν.4412 procedure as published (Απευθείας ανάθεση, Ανοιχτή διαδικασία, …)

redacted.description: true when the counterparty is a natural person (GDPR)

source_url.description: permalink to the authoritative source record

supplier_afm.description: 9-digit ΑΦΜ of a company supplier; a pseudonym "Φ-XXXXXXXXXX" for a natural-person contractor; null when the counterparty is a redacted natural person

cpvs.description: CPV classifications with their official Greek labels

discount.description: Contractor discount, only on tenders and on public-works (CPV 45) awards/contracts. The key is ABSENT when there is nothing to show (not null). basis "document" = the percentage exactly as the award decision states it (measure average_discount | discount_on_budget, with document_ref and document_url to the source), Pro plan and above. basis "calculated" = Diavgis' own 1 - award_net / tender_budget_net, single winner only, shown only when the award is 30-100% of the budget and, where the document states a figure, within 1 point of it. official_locked: true + upgrade_url = the document states an official figure this plan does not include. A calculated value is not the official one.

title: Get One Act
